sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; HARC was ranked top for safety alignment and had no exact ID/title duplicate in public data.
Read arXiv abstract and HTML full text, including mechanism sections, losses, benchmark setup, ablations, large-model table, and limitations.
Checked official GitHub and Hugging Face release pointers; no local images were required because figures/tables were expressed as Markdown tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
Flagged CodeAttack residual ASR, LLM-as-judge dependence, over-refusal increases, and limited coverage of tool-using agents.
Positioned HARC against refusal-direction work, harmfulness/refusal separation, Circuit Breakers, RepBend, SFT, DPO, and runtime steering.
Article uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; Chinese character count is 5131.
